name: list
description: Read item references and untrusted sender, subject, date and text, without changing flags. Returns a bounded page. Effect: read.

name: flag
description: Set a reversible flag on one exact item. Returns its new revision; reaches no receiver. Effect: change.

name: file_import
description: Import a regular file from configured caller folders. Returns immutable blob sha256, size, name and real path; sends nothing. Effect: change.

name: file_save
description: Save only explicitly exported blob bytes in an allowed caller folder without overwriting. Admits caller disk writes through completion, preserving recovery holds against service writes. Other programs sharing the filesystem can still exhaust space; write failures report disk full. Returns saved path and hash; never opens the file. Effect: change.

name: export_file
description: Test fixture only: explicitly export a previously caller-imported file snapshot. Internal service blobs refuse; file_save then downloads the export. Effect: change.

name: prepare_send
description: Prepare a fake message; reserve without sending. Returns the service's whole approval input including Bcc, full text and immutable attachment references. Pass it unchanged to send. Effect: change. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: send
description: Submit one prepared fake message after approval. Input must equal the whole service-provided approval. Returns operation state and per-recipient, Sent and flag stages; done means fixture acceptance. Effect: send. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: prepare_delete
description: Reserve deletion of an exact item set without deleting. Returns approval containing every reference, sender, subject and date. Pass unchanged to delete. Effect: change. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: delete
description: Delete exactly the approved fake items. Refuses changed metadata or revisions before deleting any; returns per-target stages and operation state. Effect: delete. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: operation_status
description: Read an operation including historical generations and far-side evidence. Returns recorded stages and outcome; absence of evidence never proves non-delivery. Effect: read.

name: operation_cancel
description: Cancel only a reserved operation, prepared but never submitted, expiring within 15 minutes; submitting still requires owner approval. Returns failed with cancelled reason; submitting or later cannot be cancelled. Cancel and restore reservations protect against service writes only, best effort against other programs sharing the disk. Full disk can prevent cancel; nothing submits because of a failed cancel. Effect: change.

name: operation_repair
description: Repair an adapter-qualified missing local stage as a NEW operation referencing the old id. Returns both ids and stages. Never submits recipients, never deletes again. Effect: change.

name: notice_ack
description: Acknowledge an expired or cancelled notice after reading it. Returns the operation; does not hide unresolved partial or unknown outcomes. Effect: change.
